ending-2.text: You pushed through the seemingly endless darkness of the entrance. As you Moved forward the humidity had changed and the dust was thick. This place felt both wrong and right. You pushed forward against your instinct.

ending-3.text: Although dark you weren't fearful. Beams of light piercing the cave walls lit your way. A feeling of greating meaning possesed you.

ending-4.text: You then were confronted with a bend in the path. You hoped this bend would be the last.

ending-5.text: The bend led to an open room. One in which the visibility was low. Despite this you pushed forward feeling more committed than ever.

ending-6.text: As you pushed forward the dense dust began to give way to something man-made. You didn't know what but you knew you had to approach.

ending-7.text: Getting closer and closer the dust revealed a shrine with an empty pedestal. You wondered what belonged there and why your path took you here. You got closer.

ending-8.text: Being confronted with what was seeminly the end of your journey you realised you had taken an object with you. You didn't understand why at first but now it made sense, it was to be left there.

ending-9.text: You left your object on the pedestal. Nothing happended but you felt a change in you. You accomplished your journey and with this accomplishment you turned around and left the way you came. Everytime you see that object you are reminded of this journey and are filled with all the emotions you felt along the way.
